To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we propose a new visual feature encoding technique that incorporates spatio temporal dynamics and semantic information to generate semantically richer captions and (ii) we establish new state-of-the-art results on MSVD and MSL VTT datasets for both METEOR and Rouge_L metrics.
we propose a novel visual encoding technique for video captioning which combines temporal and semantic dynamics in visual features.

1) Hierarchical temporal encoding using Fourier transform is a powerful technique that can be applied to video captioning; 2) Spatially enriched visual features from object detector can improve captioning performance; and 3) GRU based language model is simple yet effective for video captioning.
